title: Classified pinned legacy workload sources
status: Source inspection only; no legacy executable or real dataset is used for native timing or correctness claims.
scope: All116 task scenarios/13 labels in the five local specs, relevant original SQL/templates/setup/Scala and runner sources; raw sources retained at their original paths.

source_pins_from_source_baselines.DynaGox: hkustDB/DynaGox c6811db68a34ab3b32722968c4e1e821f730c5ac (remote pin recorded by docs/source_baselines.md; no local checkout)

consolidation.interpretation: Task rows are backend/data/parallelism scenarios, not distinct SQL queries.

specs.scenario_note: One CROWN query; 4 named inputs (epinions, bitcoin, berkstan, google) × 5 winbig.factor values (0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1).
7 labels × 6 backend rows; fulljoin is a spec family name, not an SQL OUTER JOIN.
No new query shapes: length4_filter (CROWN/Flink) and snb3_window (CROWN/DBToaster), each at 1,2,4,8,16,32.

query_entries.label: star_cnt
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink: GROUP BY A.src, A.window_start, A.window_end; COUNT(*); plain aggregate output. DBToaster groups only by A.src; DBToaster C++ uses nonstandard COUNT(A.dst,B.dst,C.dst,D.dst).
query_entries.shape: Four binary edge occurrences share one source variable (star); equality skeleton is alpha-acyclic and the grouping head is structurally free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Unsupported as written: GROUP BY/COUNT are R2; aggregation and window semantics need separate contracts. The native engine executes admitted set CQs; it does not execute this aggregate/window query as written.

query_entries.label: length3
query_entries.head_and_semantics: No SQL or explicit SELECT/head is present for this label. Scala maps G1(A,B), G2(B,C), G3(C,D); the job applies endpoint threshold n (spec value 0). Treat the output head/mode as unspecified pending a written query contract.
query_entries.shape: Three-edge path; full-path head would be alpha-acyclic/free-connex, but this is only a candidate because the head is not declared.
query_entries.r1: Needs explicit head, output mode, and input trace semantics. Graph path alone is not enough to admit a workload.

query_entries.label: length3_filter
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink emits path variables A.src,A.dst,C.src,C.dst plus window_start/end and uses C.dst > parameter; plain SELECT is SQL bag. DBToaster templates emit the four path variables without windows; plain SELECT is bag.
query_entries.shape: Three-edge path with a local constant predicate; full logical path head is free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Bag SELECT is unavailable in R1. Set-mode admission is a candidate only after preserving intended semantics (for example, proving uniqueness or explicitly selecting DISTINCT); HOP window input must be adapted. Local constant filter is within the bounded predicate family if its source is non-null.

query_entries.label: length4_filter
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink and DBToaster templates expose the five path vertices (Flink also emits window_start/end) and filter D.dst > parameter; plain SELECT means bag.
query_entries.shape: Four-edge path with a local constant predicate; full logical path head is free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Bag SELECT unavailable as written; set-mode needs an explicit semantics decision. Filter is a bounded local predicate for non-null input; HOP window adapter required.

query_entries.label: TwoComb
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink emits the three-edge path endpoints/interior variables plus window_start/end; DBToaster C++ adds unary V1(src) and V2(dst) endpoint filters and emits the path variables without time fields. Both use plain SELECT (bag).
query_entries.shape: Three-edge path plus endpoint unary occurrences; alpha-acyclic and free-connex with the shown full path head.
query_entries.r1: Bag semantics unavailable as written; set-mode needs explicit contract. HOP windows/materialized unary inputs need adaptation. The spec filter value 32684 does not occur in these SQL sources.

query_entries.label: snb1_window
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Person ⋈ Message ⋈ Knows by person id/creator and knows person2; Flink emits selected person/message/knows fields and window_start/end. DBToaster templates omit window columns. Plain SELECT is bag.
query_entries.shape: Three-occurrence join tree (Message—Person—Knows); shown logical head includes all join variables, so equality skeleton is free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Bag unavailable as written; set-mode needs explicit semantics. HOP/event-time/windowed input adaptation required.

query_entries.label: snb2_window
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Five occurrences: Tag, Message, MessageTag, and a self-join of Knows. Flink predicates include m_c_replyof IS NULL and k1.person1 < 100000; DBToaster templates use a string sentinel and regexp_match length check instead. Plain SELECT is bag; window columns appear only in Flink.
query_entries.shape: Acyclic join tree with a knows self-join; projected head retains the join keys used by the equality skeleton.
query_entries.r1: Bag unavailable; nullable IS NULL source requires explicit NULL adapter (current native core rejects nullable inputs); self-join itself is supported. HOP adaptation required. DBToaster predicate differs syntactically/possibly semantically.

query_entries.label: snb3_window
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Person ⋈ Message ⋈ Knows k1 ⋈ Knows k2; Flink has local k1.person1 < 100000 and cross-occurrence k2.person2 <> k1.person1. DBToaster templates replace the numeric cutoff with regexp_match and omit window fields. Plain SELECT is bag.
query_entries.shape: Acyclic equality skeleton (K1—K2—Person—Message), full logical head; cross-occurrence inequality extends it beyond an equality CQ.
query_entries.r1: Bag unavailable and cross-relation <> is unsupported in R1 (R3 comparison extension); HOP adaptation required. The local numeric cutoff is bounded. Regex/numeric predicate equivalence is unverified.

query_entries.label: dumbbell_full
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink SELECT DISTINCT emits both Triangle view tuples and bridge edge, with window fields; Triangle view applies > threshold to each triangle vertex. DBToaster templates SELECT * over seven raw edge occurrences, no DISTINCT and no matching threshold.
query_entries.shape: At the Flink view boundary, Triangle—bridge—Triangle is an acyclic path. Expanding each Triangle to raw graph edges yields two cyclic 3-cycles, so the whole raw CQ body is cyclic.
query_entries.r1: Only the outer set query over independently maintained Triangle relations is a structural candidate; raw expansion is outside free-connex R1. Triangle maintenance and HOP windows need separate adapters. DBToaster source is not the same query as written.

query_entries.label: length3_project
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink SELECT DISTINCT emits the two interior path variables plus window_start/end. DBToaster templates emit the two interior variables with plain SELECT (bag), no time fields.
query_entries.shape: Three-edge path with a contiguous internal-variable projection; H and H+F are alpha-acyclic/free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Flink set query is structurally R1-eligible after HOP/window inputs are materialized; the DBToaster bag form is not R1 as written. The native engine executes admitted set CQs; no unmodified legacy windowed SQL replay is established by this inventory.

query_entries.label: length4_project
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink SELECT DISTINCT emits three internal path vertices plus window_start/end; DBToaster templates emit the same path variables with plain SELECT (bag). Both have D.dst > parameter. No filter value is set in join_project_queries.spec; runner/build defaults it to -1.
query_entries.shape: Four-edge path with contiguous internal-variable projection; equality skeleton is free-connex.
query_entries.r1: Flink set shape is eligible after local filter binding and HOP/window adaptation; DBToaster bag form is unsupported R1. Parameter default is an implicit workload condition to make explicit.

query_entries.label: dumbbell
query_entries.head_and_semantics: Flink SELECT DISTINCT emits only bridge edge plus window fields; Triangle view filters each cycle vertex > 0 per spec. DBToaster templates emit bridge endpoints with plain SELECT over seven raw edges and no such filter.
query_entries.shape: Outer relation-level path Triangle—bridge—Triangle is free-connex for the bridge head; expanding Triangle views yields cyclic raw bodies.
query_entries.r1: Outer set query is eligible only with separately maintained Triangle inputs and adapted HOP windows; raw graph query is cyclic. DBToaster bag/filter source differs; native R1 cannot claim equivalence.

query_entries.label: snb4_window
query_entries.head_and_semantics: GROUP BY t_name,t_tagid; COUNT(DISTINCT m_messageid). Flink uses IS NULL and numeric <100000 plus HOP window views; DBToaster templates use a string sentinel and regexp_match. Window is not a group key, so aggregation spans rows from all windows in the source.
query_entries.shape: Acyclic Tag—MessageTag—Message—Knows join tree, with projected aggregate head.
query_entries.r1: Unsupported in R1: GROUP BY and distinct aggregate require R2; nullable predicate and window semantics require adapters. DBToaster predicate differs from Flink.

dialect_and_source_boundaries: Flink SQL is loaded through Flink StreamTableEnvironment; the query fragments refer to views declared in sibling SQL files. Setup uses Flink-only HOP(TABLE ..., DESCRIPTOR(...)), WATERMARK, filesystem connector DDL and ${...} interpolation. Extract query, bind a schema, resolve parameters, and adapt window outputs/expiry before native SQL use.

DBToaster and DBToaster C++ sources are custom CREATE STREAM / FROM FILE / LINE DELIMITED SQL templates, not PostgreSQL source SQL. They often omit Flink window columns and sometimes use different filters, outputs or duplicate semantics; preserve each backend variant separately.

CROWN sources are handwritten Scala ProcessFunction/Job classes rather than SQL compilation. No local *.cpp query implementation exists under experiments/; dbtoaster_cpp workload sources found here are SQL templates and prepare-data scripts. docs/source_baselines.md records a separate pinned remote DynaGox C++ baseline with fixed specializations, not a local equivalent for these labels.

Current native state per docs/sql_support.md and docs/sql_admission.md: parse/bind/normalize/admit and reference CQ/structural paths exist, but maintained SQL execution is not implemented (admission reports execution_status:not_lowered). Plain/bag SELECT and GROUP BY/COUNT are unavailable; nullable inputs are rejected; cross-relation comparisons are unavailable; streaming/window/CDC codecs are unavailable. An R1-eligible shape is not current executable SQL support.
runner_modes_and_trace_gaps: execute_all.sh selects crown with fullEnumEnable=true/deltaEnumEnable=false and crown_delta with the inverse; DbToaster is invoked with --no-output; Trill output defaults false. This is runner behavior, not fully encoded per workload in the specs.

Specs provide datasets, thresholds, input.insert.only=false on selected DBToaster rows, window factors and parallelism, but do not provide canonical trace files, seeds, per-source update contracts, checksums, or a common expected output-mode contract. Flink HOP inputs need an explicit event-time/window-expiry trace adapter; CROWN documents +/- graph events and * enumeration trigger, but the spec does not pin traces.

Add explicit mode labels for current snapshot, per-commit set delta, bag multiplicity, aggregate changes, and output-suppressed maintenance; retain backend-specific expected semantics. Do not equate a spec label with cross-backend semantic identity without normalization/oracle evidence.
data_and_license_gaps: No benchmark CSV/raw data files or data checksums were found under experiments. Paths are external placeholders or dataset names; enclosureness names epinions, bitcoin, berkstan, google, but no license/provenance is recorded here.

No dataset license files or checksum manifest were found under experiments. docs/source_baselines.md reports no root project LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING and does not choose a project or legacy-source license; vendored notices are component-specific and do not license these datasets.

Flink/DBToaster templates reference external paths such as ${path.to.data.raw}, dbtoaster.message.window.csv, and dbtoaster_cpp.graph1.csv. Dataset generation/conversion source does not pin produced bytes, seeds, or source-data redistribution rights.
The three experiments/snbquery/query1-3.sql files are standalone non-spec DBToaster examples and are not interchangeable with snb1_window/snb2_window/snb3_window.
coverage_gap: The legacy set includes graph paths, internal projections, stars, endpoint unary filters, two macro-dumbbell shapes, and several SNB joins, but it does not cover the all-free-connex class from Refactor.md §2.2. Keep the generated structural families in the parent manifest (arbitrary arity, self-joins/repeated and contained scopes, disconnected products, Boolean/projection heads and deeper/generalized joins); graph-only legacy coverage must remain labeled as such.

corrections: Two stale statements implying the current native engine cannot execute maintained SQL were corrected; raw legacy SQL remains adaptation-required.
